production.format_and_medium.summary: Data that is a public record in its original form remains a public record when maintained in computer files.

production.delivery_and_completion.summary: Independent of the four-day cap, the custodian must respond as soon as is practicable and without delay.
production.delivery_and_completion.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "as soon as is practicable and without delay" from actual receipt

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: A governmental entity is not required to acquire computer capability to generate public records in a new or different form when that new form would require additional computer equipment or software the entity does not already possess.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any resident of the state and any other person interested in examining public records is empowered to examine those records and make memoranda, copies, and abstracts, free of charge, during office business hours.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester need not state a reason or purpose to examine or obtain public records; the right to examine attaches to any interested person without a purpose condition.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: Eligibility to examine and copy public records is not limited to residents; 'all other persons interested in the examination of the public records' are equally authorized, so no residency or citizenship qualification gates the right.

Master.s1.label: Fee-waiver requested

fee.waiver.summary: The custodian may waive or reduce any fee if the waiver or reduction would be in the public interest.

Master.s1.city_config: fee_waiver approval module (v1, DESIGN_fee_waiver_commercial.md): enabled on/off governs the DISCRETIONARY program only — statutory-mandatory waiver categories fire regardless, on verified evidence. mode = intake_review (inline approve/deny) | routed_task {assignee_role, task_name}.

Master.s2.label: Commercial-rate requested
Master.s2.city_config: commercial_rate approval module (v1): same two modes as fee_waiver (intake_review | routed_task). Must decide at INTAKE — commercial classification changes the response clock in NJ (14-bd) and IL (recurrent/commercial track). Classification overriding a self-declaration is always communicated.

Estimate-Fee.dwv.label: Fee waiver

fee.waiver.summary: The custodian may waive or reduce any fee if the waiver or reduction would be in the public interest.

Estimate-Fee.dwv.city_config: Waiver decision point: resolved AFTER estimate computed, BEFORE estimate communicated — a waiver is always decided before any amount is invoiced. Denial is folded into the estimate notice (no separate letter); processing never stops — flows to the requester-response gate.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: A custodian may charge a fee for providing copies, but the fee shall not exceed the actual added cost of making the copies available.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: When a county custodian provides a copy by transmitting it modem-to-modem, a reasonable fee may be charged for the specialized service, which may include a reasonable amortization of added computer equipment/software cost.
